newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK democrats send China dissidents Christmas cards.
newsitem.headline: HK democrats send China dissidents Christmas cards.

text.p: Hong Kong pro-democracy campaigners on Tuesday shared their festive spirit with thousands of jailed dissidents in China on Tuesday by sending them Christmas cards.
The Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements in China mailed more than 8,000 Christmas cards to China.
"We want to take the opportunity to express our concern and support for (the dissidents)," a spokeswoman for the alliance told Reuters.
The group has been sending Christmas cards to jailed Chinese dissidents since 1989 when Beijing authorities cracked down on a student-led democracy movement in the Chinese capital.
China takes over Hong Kong on July 1 next year after more than 150 years of British rule.
